QPE_FFGMAX.label: QPE as % of FFG, max of 1/3/6 h

lines: Best placement of the ≥ 1″ area: REFS LPMM (ETS 0.02).
Closest on the peak: RRFS, 1.25″ vs 2.67″ observed at its resolution (47%).
Far too dry overall (under half the observed rain volume): NWS official QPF 47%.
Earliest signal: GFS reached half the observed peak 120 h before the window started.
summary.method: Score = mean of placement (ETS at the event threshold ÷ 0.5, capped at 1), peak (e^-|ln ratio| of forecast to observed near-max at the model's resolution) and volume (e^-|ln bias|), each from the model's shortest-lead run.
